//: Development only. Uploaded files are served by the API, but the public site and the CMS reference them by a root-relative path such as /uploads/banners/x.jpg. In production the two are one origin (IIS serves the site and the API as a sub-application), so the path resolves. Under `ng serve` they are two ports, and without this every uploaded image renders broken in the CMS and on the site.
//theme: The colour theme's stylesheet is linked from index.html by a root-relative /api address, which in production is the same origin; under ng serve it has to be passed through to the API.
